summary: ISQ Open Infrastructure Co LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of equity securities (Item 3.02) and a monthly transactional net asset value update (Item 8.01). The company issued multiple classes of shares for total net consideration of $12,965,396. These are routine capital-raising activities under Regulation D and S exemptions, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic event. The filing merely discloses ongoing share issuance at NAV and periodic NAV determination.
